text:
clara-finance: Quick heads-up  two new procurement clarifications effective immediately: 1) how we treat prepaid vendor credits and 2) vendor diversity checks on larger RFPs. Please skim and flag questions. https://redwood.company/finance/prepaid-credits-diversity :sparkles:

procurement-bot: POLICY UPDATE by @clara-finance
- Prepaid credits (vendor wallets/consumable credits): if prepay > $10k, finance will treat as deferred expense and require capex/expense justification. Attach vendor invoice showing credit terms.
- Carryover: unused prepaid credits can be carried forward for up to 12 months if documented in the PO; otherwise they expire.
- Vendor diversity: for any RFP or vendor spend > $50k, include a vendor-diversity check. Preference scoring (5%) will be applied for certified SMB/Minority/Woman-owned vendors.
- Quick commands: `/procure credit-onboard` to register a prepaid credit, `/procure diversity-check` to run the diversity check scan.

mike-ops: to clarify  our CDN partner offered a $15k onboarding credit on a 36-month deal. Does that trigger deferred treatment?

clara-finance: @mike-ops yes  because the credit > $10k we treat it as deferred until consumed; include credit schedule in the procure request and we'll map to GL deferred ledger `GL-2000`. If the credit is refundable or tied to committed spend, note that in the vendor terms.

mike-ops: ok will attach the portal screenshot and credit schedule. Any sample PO snippet we should copy?

clara-finance: example snippet to paste into the request:

```
Project: Edge CDN migration
Vendor: StreamFast LLC
Amount: $120,000 (includes $15,000 onboarding credit)
Credit treatment: $15,000 deferred credit, consume over 12 months
Business justification: reduce egress cost and improve latency for EU region
Contact: infra@redwood.com
```

procurement-bot: Reminder: missing credit schedules will delay approvals. Finance will not finalize deferred accounting without vendor docs.

sarah-legal: Note on contracts  if the credit terms affect termination liabilities or MSAs, tag legal. We need to ensure credits cannot be clawed back on termination without notice.

vp-gabe: On diversity  add a small ops ask: if teams identify certified diverse vendors, please ping procurement so we can qualify them proactively. We want a pipeline.

clara-finance: Great point @vp-gabe. Procurement will maintain a "Diverse Vendor Pool" list. If you want to nominate a vendor for the pool, use `/procure nominate-diverse` and attach certification docs. We'll triage within 5 business days.

mike-ops: timeline on diversity checks for an active RFP? We have an RFP closing next week for a $60k tool.

procurement-bot: For RFPs >$50k, diversity check is included in the standard evaluation. If you need the 5% preference applied before award, flag `--apply-diversity-boost` on the RFP form and attach proof.

clara-finance: Final notes: policy version 2026-05-07_prepaid_diversity_v1. Archive link: https://redwood.company/finance/archive. I'll run a 20-min drop-in on Friday 9am PT to walk teams through credit accounting and the nominate flow. Drop edge cases here or DM me.

mike-ops: thanks, joining the drop-in. one more  GL mapping for deferred credits?

clara-finance: use `GL-2000` for deferred vendor credits, expense consumption posts to the functional GL (e.g., infra GL-4001) as consumed. We'll publish an FAQ with examples.

procurement-bot: automated reminder: donate vendors to the Diverse Vendor Pool by 2026-05-14 for Q2 procurement visibility.

vp-gabe: Love this. Thanks Clara and team :clap:
